movie.title: Pokiri
movie.summary: Pandu is a contract killer and will accept any contract provided the amount is right. The police want him for questioning, while the underworld needs him to silence their opponents. No one really knows this assassin's background. It is only Pandu who knows his real identity, and he has no intention of sharing it with anyone.

movie.title: The Dark Knight Rises
movie.tagline: The legend ends.
movie.summary: Following the death of District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman assumes responsibility for Dent's crimes to protect the late attorney's reputation and is subsequently hunted by the Gotham City Police Department. Eight years later, Batman encounters the mysterious Selina Kyle and the villainous Bane, a new terrorist leader who overwhelms Gotham's finest. The Dark Knight resurfaces to protect a city that has branded him an enemy.

movie.title: The Dark Knight
movie.tagline: Welcome to a world without rules.
movie.summary: Batman raises the stakes in his war on crime. With the help of Lt. Jim Gordon and District Attorney Harvey Dent, Batman sets out to dismantle the remaining criminal organizations that plague the streets. The partnership proves to be effective, but they soon find themselves prey to a reign of chaos unleashed by a rising criminal mastermind known to the terrified citizens of Gotham as the Joker.

movie.title: The Bourne Supremacy
movie.tagline: They should have left him alone.
movie.summary: A CIA operation to purchase classified Russian documents is blown by a rival agent, who then shows up in the sleepy seaside village where Bourne and Marie have been living. The pair run for their lives and Bourne, who promised retaliation should anyone from his former life attempt contact, is forced to once again take up his life as a trained assassin to survive.

movie.title: A Good Day to Die Hard
The Bourne Identity
movie.tagline: He was the perfect weapon until he became the target.
movie.summary: Wounded to the brink of death and suffering from amnesia, Jason Bourne is rescued at sea by a fisherman. With nothing to go on but a Swiss bank account number, he starts to reconstruct his life, but finds that many people he encounters want him dead. However, Bourne realizes that he has the combat and mental skills of a world-class spy—but who does he work for?

movie.title: Braveheart
movie.tagline: Every man dies, not every man really lives.
movie.summary: Enraged at the slaughter of Murron, his new bride and childhood love, Scottish warrior William Wallace slays a platoon of the local English lord's soldiers. This leads the village to revolt and, eventually, the entire country to rise up against English rule.

movie.title: City Lights
movie.tagline: True Blind Love
movie.summary: A tramp falls in love with a beautiful blind flower girl. His on-and-off friendship with a wealthy man allows him to be the girl's benefactor and suitor.

movie.title: The Kid
movie.tagline: 6 reels of Joy.
movie.summary: A tramp cares for a boy after he's abandoned as a newborn by his mother. Later the mother has a change of heart and aches to be reunited with her son.

movie.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
Modern Times
movie.tagline: He stands alone as the greatest entertainer of modern times! No one on earth can make you laugh as heartily or touch your heart as deeply...the whole world laughs, cries and thrills to his priceless genius!
movie.summary: A bumbling tramp desires to build a home with a young woman, yet is thwarted time and time again by his lack of experience and habit of being in the wrong place at the wrong time...

movie.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
movie.tagline: What is hidden in snow, comes forth in the thaw.
movie.summary: Disgraced journalist Mikael Blomkvist investigates the disappearance of a weary patriarch's niece from 40 years ago. He is aided by the pierced, tattooed, punk computer hacker named Lisbeth Salander. As they work together in the investigation, Blomkvist and Salander uncover immense corruption beyond anything they have ever imagined.

movie.title: Magnolia
movie.tagline: Things fall down. People look up. And when it rains, it pours.
movie.summary: On one random day in the San Fernando Valley, a dying father, a young wife, a male caretaker, a famous lost son, a police officer in love, a boy genius, an ex-boy genius, a game show host and an estranged daughter will each become part of a dazzling multiplicity of plots, but one story.

movie.title: Paris, Texas
movie.tagline: A place for dreams. A place for heartbreak. A place to pick up the pieces.
movie.summary: A man wanders out of the desert not knowing who he is. His brother finds him, and helps to pull his memory back of the life he led before he walked out on his family and disappeared four years earlier.

movie.title: Sarfarosh
movie.tagline: A Reason To Live
movie.summary: When terrorists kill a cop's brother and disable his father, he fights back against the smuggling of guns and drugs which plagues his country.

movie.title: Ab Tak Chhappan
movie.tagline: Doctors Cure, Engineers Build, I Kill
movie.summary: Following the fortunes of tough cop Sadhu Agashe both in his fight against crime and in his personal life. Garnering newspaper headlines for his crime-fighting activities, he also makes some enemies in the police department, most notably in the form of his superior, who believes his officer has gone too far.

movie.title: GoodFellas
movie.tagline: Three decades of life in the mafia.
movie.summary: The true story of Henry Hill, a half-Irish, half-Sicilian Brooklyn kid who is adopted by neighbourhood gangsters at an early age and climbs the ranks of a Mafia family under the guidance of Jimmy Conway.

movie.title: Colour Photo
movie.summary: Jayakrishna is a dark-skinned guy who falls head over heels on Deepu but keeps his feelings to himself. As time passes by, a gang in his college beats him up and this issue brings Deepu closer to him. Slowly the friendship turns into love and this does not go well with Deepu’s brother Rama Raju. The rest of the story is as to how the couple reunites after facing several problems.

movie.title: Serious Men
movie.summary: Tormented with his 'under-privileged' societal status, a father capitalizes on his son's newfound fame as a boy-genius. Little does he realize that the secret he harbors will destroy the very thing he loves the most.

movie.title: Ratatouille
movie.tagline: He's dying to become a chef.
movie.summary: Remy, a rat, possesses a palate far more refined than that of his fellow comrades. He dreams of becoming a chef, one who creates rather than scavenges. When fate deposits him in the sewers beneath one of Paris’s most famous restaurants, he finds himself ideally placed to fulfill his dream. Forming an unusual alliance with a hapless young kitchen worker, Remy begins a daring culinary double life.  As Remy pursues his vision, he must navigate the suspicions of the calculating Head Chef Skinner, the disapproval of Remy’s own colony, and the foreboding presence of renowned food critic Anton Ego, who strikes fear in the hearts of chefs all throughout France.

movie.title: Casino
movie.tagline: No one stays at the top forever.
movie.summary: In Las Vegas, two best friends--a casino executive and a Mafia enforcer--compete for a gambling empire and a fast-living, fast-loving socialite.

movie.title: Gone Girl
movie.tagline: You don't know what you've got 'til it's...
movie.summary: With his wife's disappearance having become the focus of an intense media circus, a man sees the spotlight turned on him when it's suspected that he may not be innocent.

movie.title: Safe
movie.tagline: She has the code. He is the key.
movie.summary: After a former elite agent rescues a 12-year-old Chinese girl who's been abducted, they find themselves in the middle of a standoff between Triads, the Russian Mafia and high-level corrupt New York City politicians and police.

movie.title: Léon: The Professional
movie.tagline: If you want the job done right, hire a professional.
movie.summary: Léon, the top hit man in New York, has earned a rep as an effective "cleaner". But when his next-door neighbors are wiped out by a loose-cannon DEA agent, he becomes the unwilling custodian of 12-year-old Mathilda. Before long, Mathilda's thoughts turn to revenge, and she considers following in Léon's footsteps.

movie.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movie.tagline: It's time to step up.
movie.summary: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

movie.title: #Alive
movie.tagline: You must survive.
movie.summary: As a grisly virus rampages a city, a lone man stays locked inside his apartment, digitally cut off from seeking help and desperate to find a way out.

movie.title: C U Soon
movie.summary: Jimmy meets Anu on an online dating website and decides to marry her. Jimmy's mother entrusts his cousin Kevin to get details about Anu. Now it's Kevin's turn to search for his cousin's fiancee who vanished without a trace, only to discover dark, shocking truths about her.

movie.title: Agneepath
movie.tagline: The Path of Fire.
movie.summary: When his father is lynched by a mob after being framed by a gangster, a young boy leaves his village along with his pregnant mother  and flees to Mumbai. He takes up a life of crime and swears to avenge his father. A remake of the 1990 film.

movie.title: X-Men Origins: Wolverine
movie.tagline: Witness the origin.
movie.summary: After seeking to live a normal life after 200 years, Logan sets out to avenge a death by undergoing the mutant Weapon X program and becoming Wolverine.

movie.title: V
movie.summary: A celebrated cop, DCP Aditya, faces his toughest challenge when a taunting serial killer begins targeting victims and leaving notes meant for him. Teaming with an aspiring crime novelist, he must stop four more murders to save his medals, career, and reputation while uncovering the killer's past.

movie.title: Inception
movie.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.
movie.summary: Cobb, a skilled thief who commits corporate espionage by infiltrating the subconscious of his targets is offered a chance to regain his old life as payment for a task considered to be impossible: "inception", the implantation of another person's idea into a target's subconscious.

movie.title: Alita: Battle Angel
movie.tagline: ​"I do not stand by in the presence of evil."
movie.summary: When Alita awakens with no memory of who she is in a future world she does not recognize, she is taken in by Ido, a compassionate doctor who realizes that somewhere in this abandoned cyborg shell is the heart and soul of a young woman with an extraordinary past.

movie.title: Le Samouraï
movie.tagline: His only friend was his gun!
movie.summary: After carrying out a flawlessly planned hit, Jef Costello, a contract killer with samurai instincts, finds himself caught between a persistent police investigator and a ruthless employer, and not even his armor of fedora and trench coat can protect him.

movie.title: Revanche
movie.tagline: Whose fault is it if life doesn't go your way?
movie.summary: Alex, an ex-con working as muscle in a Vienna brothel, dreams of escaping with his girlfriend Tamara, who also works there. Their attempt to break free sets off a chain of events that links their fate with a rural police officer and his troubled marriage. As their lives intersect, a quiet struggle unfolds between guilt, grief, and the desire for redemption.

movie.title: Blade Runner
movie.tagline: Man has made his match... now it's his problem.
movie.summary: In the smog-choked dystopian Los Angeles of 2019, blade runner Rick Deckard is called out of retirement to terminate a quartet of replicants who have escaped to Earth seeking their creator for a way to extend their short life spans.

movie.title: Aquaman
movie.tagline: Home is calling.
movie.summary: Half-human, half-Atlantean Arthur Curry is taken on the journey of his lifetime to discover if he is worth of being a king.

movie.title: Fight Club
movie.tagline: Mischief. Mayhem. Soap.
movie.summary: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
movie.tagline: It all ends.
movie.summary: Harry, Ron and Hermione continue their quest to vanquish the evil Voldemort once and for all. Just as things begin to look hopeless for the young wizards, Harry discovers a trio of magical objects that endow him with powers to rival Voldemort's formidable skills.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
movie.tagline: Nowhere is safe.
movie.summary: Harry, Ron and Hermione walk away from their last year at Hogwarts to find and destroy the remaining Horcruxes, putting an end to Voldemort's bid for immortality. But with Harry's beloved Dumbledore dead and Voldemort's unscrupulous Death Eaters on the loose, the world is more dangerous than ever.

movie.title: Project Power
movie.tagline: What would you risk for five minutes of pure power?
movie.summary: An ex-soldier, a teen and a cop collide in New Orleans as they hunt for the source behind a dangerous new pill that grants users temporary superpowers.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
movie.tagline: Dark secrets revealed.
movie.summary: Dumbledore tries to prepare Harry for the final battle with Voldemort while Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
movie.tagline: The rebellion begins.
movie.summary: When a new professor's methods leave Hogwarts unprepared to fight the rising tide of evil, Harry teaches students how to defend against the dark arts.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
movie.tagline: Dark and difficult times lie ahead.
movie.summary: When his name emerges from the Goblet of Fire, Harry Potter becomes a competitor in a grueling battle for glory among three wizarding schools. Signs of Voldemort's return emerge as Harry's friends help him prepare for the Triwizard Tournament.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
movie.tagline: Something wicked this way comes.
movie.summary: Harry Potter's life is in danger once more as dangerous wizard Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban Prison and is heading to Hogwarts.

movie.title: Uma Maheswara Ugra Roopasya
movie.summary: Defeated and humiliated in a fight while trying to defuse a conflict among his fellow villagers, a photographer vows revenge on his attacker.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
movie.tagline: Something evil has returned to Hogwarts!
movie.summary: Cars fly, trees fight back, and a mysterious house-elf comes to warn Harry Potter at the start of his second year at Hogwarts. Adventure and danger await when bloody writing on a wall announces: The Chamber Of Secrets Has Been Opened. To save Hogwarts will require all of Harry, Ron and Hermione's magical abilities and courage.

movie.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone
movie.tagline: Let the magic begin.
movie.summary: Harry Potter has lived under the stairs at his aunt and uncle's house his whole life. But on his 11th birthday, he learns he's a powerful wizard—with a place waiting for him at the Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry. As he learns to harness his newfound powers with the help of the school's kindly headmaster, Harry uncovers the truth about his parents' deaths—and about the villain who's to blame.

movie.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movie.tagline: The future belongs to the mad.
movie.summary: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

movie.title: Mad Max 2
movie.tagline: Just one man can make a difference.
movie.summary: Max Rockatansky returns as the heroic loner who drives the dusty roads of a postapocalyptic Australian Outback in an unending search for gasoline. Arrayed against him and the other scraggly defendants of a fuel-depot encampment are the bizarre warriors commanded by the charismatic Lord Humungus, a violent leader whose scruples are as barren as the surrounding landscape.

movie.title: Dil Bechara
movie.summary: Kizie and Manny, two ordinary people brought together by a tragic twist, embark on a bittersweet and extraordinary journey into the heart of that crazy little thing called 'life'.

movie.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome
movie.tagline: Hold out for Mad Max. This is his greatest adventure.
movie.summary: Mad Max becomes a pawn in a decadent oasis of a technological society, and when exiled, becomes the deliverer of a colony of children.

movie.title: Satya
movie.tagline: The Other Side of Truth
movie.summary: A young man named Satya comes to Mumbai from South India in search of a job. Jailed for something he did not do, the once-honest young man meets an underworld boss, Bhiku Mhatre in jail and joins his gang.

movie.title: The Terminal
movie.tagline: Life is waiting.
movie.summary: An Eastern European tourist unexpectedly finds himself stranded in JFK airport, and must take up temporary residence there.

movie.title: The Vast of Night
movie.tagline: There’s something in the sky.
movie.summary: At the dawn of the space-race, two radio-obsessed teens discover a strange frequency over the airwaves in what becomes the most important night of their lives and in the history of their small town.

movie.title: Zero Dark Thirty
movie.tagline: The greatest manhunt in history.
movie.summary: A chronicle of the decade-long hunt for al-Qaeda terrorist leader Osama bin Laden after the September 2001 attacks, and his death at the hands of the Navy S.E.A.L. Team 6 in May, 2011.

movie.title: Greyhound
movie.tagline: The only thing more dangerous than the front lines was the fight to get there.
movie.summary: A first-time captain leads a convoy of allied ships carrying thousands of soldiers across the treacherous waters of the "Black Pit" to the front lines of WWII. With no air cover protection for 5 days, the captain and his convoy must battle the surrounding enemy Nazi U-boats in order to give the allies a chance to win the war.

movie.title: Solo: A Star Wars Story
movie.tagline: Never tell him the odds.
movie.summary: Through a series of daring escapades deep within a dark and dangerous criminal underworld, Han Solo meets his mighty future copilot Chewbacca and encounters the notorious gambler Lando Calrissian.

movie.title: The Old Guard
movie.tagline: Forever is harder than it looks.
movie.summary: Four undying warriors who've secretly protected humanity for centuries become targeted for their mysterious powers just as they discover a new immortal.

movie.title: Lagaan: Once Upon a Time in India
movie.tagline: Once upon a time in India
movie.summary: The year is 1893 and India is under British occupation. In a small village, the tyrannical Captain Russell has imposed an unprecedented land tax on its citizens. Outraged, Bhuvan, a rebellious farmer, rallies the villagers to publicly oppose the tax. Russell offers a novel way to settle the dispute: he challenges Bhuvan and his men to a game of cricket, a sport completely foreign to India. If Bhuvan and his men can defeat Russell's team, the tax will be repealed.

movie.title: The Shawshank Redemption
movie.tagline: Fear can hold you prisoner. Hope can set you free.
movie.summary: Imprisoned in the 1940s for the double murder of his wife and her lover, upstanding banker Andy Dufresne begins a new life at the Shawshank prison, where he puts his accounting skills to work for an amoral warden. During his long stretch in prison, Dufresne comes to be admired by the other inmates -- including an older prisoner named Red -- for his integrity and unquenchable sense of hope.

movie.title: Mulan
movie.tagline: The flower that blooms in adversity is the most rare and beautiful of all.
movie.summary: When Imperial China calls one man from every family to defend the empire from invading Huns, a young woman disguises herself as a soldier to take her ailing father’s place. Facing ruthless invaders, brutal training, and the risk of execution if discovered, she must decide who she truly is— and what she’s willing to fight for.

movie.title: The Rocketeer
movie.tagline: An Ordinary Man Forced to Become An Extraordinary Hero.
movie.summary: A stunt pilot comes across a prototype jetpack that gives him the ability to fly. However, evil forces of the world also want this jetpack at any cost.

movie.title: Onward
movie.tagline: Their quest beginneth.
movie.summary: In a suburban fantasy world, two teenage elf brothers embark on an extraordinary quest to discover if there is still a little magic left out there.

movie.title: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: The Last Jedi
movie.tagline: Let the past die.
movie.summary: Rey develops her newly discovered abilities with the guidance of Luke Skywalker, who is unsettled by the strength of her powers. Meanwhile, the Resistance prepares to do battle with the First Order.

movie.title: Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith
Star Wars: Episode II - Attack of the Clones
Star Wars: Episode I - The Phantom Menace
The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
Schindler's List
movie.tagline: Whoever saves one life, saves the world entire.
movie.summary: The true story of how businessman Oskar Schindler saved over a thousand Jewish lives from the Nazis while they worked as slaves in his factory during World War II.

movie.title: Gangs of Wasseypur - Part 1
movie.tagline: I am a hunter... dekho meri gun!
movie.summary: In 1970s India, Sardar Khan vows to take revenge on the man who killed his father decades earlier.

movie.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
The Godfather Part II
movie.tagline: The rise and fall of the Corleone empire.
movie.summary: In the continuing saga of the Corleone crime family, a young Vito Corleone grows up in Sicily and in 1910s New York. In the 1950s, Michael Corleone attempts to expand the family business into Las Vegas, Hollywood and Cuba.

movie.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movie.tagline: The future belongs to the mad.
movie.summary: An apocalyptic story set in the furthest reaches of our planet, in a stark desert landscape where humanity is broken, and most everyone is crazed fighting for the necessities of life. Within this world exist two rebels on the run who just might be able to restore order.

movie.title: The Godfather
movie.tagline: An offer you can't refuse.
movie.summary: Spanning the years 1945 to 1955, a chronicle of the fictional Italian-American Corleone crime family. When organized crime family patriarch, Vito Corleone barely survives an attempt on his life, his youngest son, Michael steps in to take care of the would-be killers, launching a campaign of bloody revenge.

movie.title: Back to the Future Part II
The Good, the Bad, the Weird
Captain Marvel
movie.tagline: Higher. Further. Faster.
movie.summary: The story follows Carol Danvers as she becomes one of the universe’s most powerful heroes when Earth is caught in the middle of a galactic war between two alien races. Set in the 1990s, Captain Marvel is an all-new adventure from a previously unseen period in the history of the Marvel Cinematic Universe.

movie.title: A Bittersweet Life
movie.tagline: When doing right goes very, very wrong.
movie.summary: Kim Sun-woo is an enforcer and manager for a hotel owned by a cold, calculative crime boss, Kang who assigns Sun-woo to a simple errand while he is away on a business trip; to shadow his young mistress, Hee-soo, for fear that she may be cheating on him with a younger man with the mandate that he must kill them both if he discovers their affair.

movie.title: Soni
movie.summary: Soni, a young policewoman in Delhi, and her superintendent, Kalpana, have collectively taken on a growing crisis of violent crimes against women. However, their alliance suffers a major setback when Soni is transferred out for alleged misconduct on duty.

movie.title: The Man from Nowhere
movie.tagline: Nothing to lose, nothing to compromise.
movie.summary: A reclusive pawnshop owner goes on a brutal rampage to rescue a young girl kidnapped by a criminal organization.

movie.title: The Lighthouse
movie.tagline: There is enchantment in the light.
movie.summary: Two lighthouse keepers try to maintain their sanity while living on a remote and mysterious New England island in the 1890s.

movie.title: The Lift Boy
movie.summary: A coming of age story of a 24-year-old vagabond who is forced to work at a posh building in Mumbai as a Lift Boy when his bread-winning father falls ill.

movie.title: Mrs. Serial Killer
movie.tagline: A killer love story.
movie.summary: When her husband is framed and imprisoned for serial murders, a doting wife must perform a copycat murder, to prove her husband's innocence.

movie.title: The Platform
movie.tagline: There are 3 kinds of people; the ones above, the ones below, and the ones who fall.
movie.summary: A slab of food descends down a vertical facility. The residents above eat heartily, leaving those below starving and desperate. A rebellion is imminent.

movie.title: Extraction
movie.tagline: When the mission ends, redemption begins
movie.summary: A hardened gun-for-hire's latest mission becomes a soul-searching race to survive when he's sent into Bangladesh to rescue a drug lord's kidnapped son.

movie.title: Rambo: Last Blood
movie.tagline: Everyone has one more fight in them.
movie.summary: After fighting his demons for decades, John Rambo now lives in peace on his family ranch in Arizona, but his rest is interrupted when Gabriela, the granddaughter of his housekeeper María, disappears after crossing the border into Mexico to meet her biological father. Rambo, who has become a true father figure for Gabriela over the years, undertakes a desperate and dangerous journey to find her.

movie.title: Adoration
movie.summary: Lil and Roz are two lifelong friends, having grown up together as neighbors in an idyllic beach town. As adults, their sons have developed a friendship as strong as that which binds their mothers. One summer, all four are confronted by simmering emotions that have been mounting between them, and each find unexpected happiness in relationships that cross the bounds of convention.

movie.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
movie.tagline: Don't regret. Remember.
movie.summary: On an isolated island in Brittany at the end of the eighteenth century, a female painter is obliged to paint a wedding portrait of a young woman.

movie.title: Kalki
movie.summary: A police officer gets assigned to investigate a crime scene in a town and finds out about a chain of crimes surrounding it. He begins digging deeper and finds out there’s more to it than what’s on surface.

movie.title: Nobody Knows
movie.tagline: Did mom really abandon us?
movie.summary: In a small Tokyo apartment, twelve-year-old Akira must care for his younger siblings after their mother leaves them and shows no sign of returning.

movie.title: Raja Vaaru Rani Gaaru
movie.tagline: A Nostalgic Ride
movie.summary: Raja, a young man, falls in love with Rani but is unable to express his feelings to her for fear of getting rejected. However, his friends decide to step in and help him woo her.

movie.title: True Grit
movie.tagline: Punishment comes one way or another.
movie.summary: Following the murder of her father by a hired hand, a 14-year-old farm girl sets out to capture the killer. To aid her, she hires the toughest U.S. Marshal she can find—a man with 'true grit'—Reuben J. 'Rooster' Cogburn.

movie.title: Ri¢hie Ri¢h
movie.tagline: Five buddies, one butler, and a dog on an adventure so big... even the world's richest kid can't afford to miss it.
movie.summary: Billionaire heir Richie Rich has it all, including Reggie Jackson as a batting coach and Claudia Schiffer as a personal trainer -- but no playmates. What's more, scoundrel Laurence Van Dough is scheming to take over the family empire. Uh-oh! Enter faithful butler Cadbury to save the day.

movie.title: Shubh Mangal Zyada Saavdhan
movie.tagline: Jeetega Pyaar Seh-Parivaar
movie.summary: Partners Karthik and Aman don't have it easy in their road to achieving a happy ending, while Aman's family tries to get him married to someone else, Karthik doesn't step down unless he marries Aman.  A sequel to the 2017 film, titled Shubh Mangal Saavdhan.

movie.title: HIT: The First Case
movie.summary: Vikram Rudraraju is a 30-year-old cop working for the Telangana State Police. While Vikram is battling with his own traumatic past, the stakes get high when a girl called Preethi mysteriously disappears in Hyderabad and Vikram has to solve the case at any cost.

movie.title: Bheeshma
movie.tagline: Single forever
movie.summary: Bheeshma Prasad, a simple meme creator has his life turned around when he wages a war against a powerful agro company that creates harmful chemicals to increase the crop yield and make more money.

movie.title: Little Women
movie.tagline: Own your story.
movie.summary: Four sisters come of age in America in the aftermath of the Civil War.

movie.title: Ford v Ferrari
movie.tagline: They took the American dream for a ride.
movie.summary: American car designer Carroll Shelby and the British-born driver Ken Miles work together to battle corporate interference, the laws of physics, and their own personal demons to build a revolutionary race car for Ford Motor Company and take on the dominating race cars of Enzo Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in France in 1966.

movie.title: Tanhaji: The Unsung Warrior
movie.tagline: The Unsung Warrior
movie.summary: When Aurangzeb recruits his trusted soldier Udaybhan to control the Kondhana fort, Shivaji's military leader Tanhaji Malusare and his army of Maratha warriors set out to recapture the fortress.

movie.title: American Assassin
movie.tagline: Assassins aren't born. They're made.
movie.summary: Following the murder of his fiancée, Mitch Rapp trains under the instruction of Cold War veteran Stan Hurley. The pair then is enlisted to investigate a wave of apparently random attacks on military and civilian targets.

movie.title: Parasite
movie.tagline: Act like you own the place.
movie.summary: All unemployed, Ki-taek's family takes peculiar interest in the wealthy and glamorous Parks for their livelihood until they get entangled in an unexpected incident.

movie.title: Aswathama
movie.summary: After learning his sister has been mysteriously impregnated, Gana sets out to hunt down the culprit as he discovers similar cases in the city.

movie.tagline: Time is the enemy.
movie.summary: At the height of the First World War, two young British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a message that will stop a deadly attack on hundreds of soldiers.

movie.title: Panga
movie.summary: 'Panga' follows the triumphs and struggle of a national level Kabbadi player from India who receives the love and support from her family to help achieve her dream.

movie.title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
movie.summary: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son.

movie.title: Super 30
movie.summary: Based on life of Patna-based mathematician Anand Kumar who runs the famed Super 30 program for financially weak IIT aspirants in Patna.

movie.title: Joker
movie.tagline: Put on a happy face.
movie.summary: During the 1980s, a failed stand-up comedian is driven insane and turns to a life of crime and chaos in Gotham City while becoming an infamous psychopathic crime figure.

movie.title: Marriage Story
movie.tagline: Where there's a love, there's a way.
movie.summary: A stage director and an actress struggle through a grueling, coast-to-coast divorce that pushes them to their personal extremes.

movie.title: The Sky Is Pink
movie.tagline: Har Ek Ka Apna Sky Hota Hain.
movie.summary: The 25-year-old love story of a couple is told through the lens of their teenage daughter after she is diagnosed with pulmonary fibrosis.

movie.title: The Two Popes
movie.tagline: Inspired by true events.
movie.summary: Frustrated with the direction of the church, Cardinal Bergoglio requests permission to retire in 2012 from Pope Benedict. Instead, facing scandal and self-doubt, the introspective Pope Benedict summons his harshest critic and future successor to Rome to reveal a secret that would shake the foundations of the Catholic Church.

movie.title: Darbar
movie.tagline: To battle monsters, become a monster.
movie.summary: Aaditya, the commissioner of Mumbai Police, sets out to catch Ajay, a drug peddler. However, he uncovers a deeper controversy linked to an international drug lord and must mete out justice.

movie.title: Sarileru Neekevvaru
movie.summary: A tough army major is deployed to Kurnool on a mission to keep the country safe from external threats.

movie.title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
movie.summary: After growing up enduring criticism from his father, a young man finds his world shaken upon learning he was switched at birth with a millionaire's son.

movie.title: Bluff Master
movie.summary: A young lad turns a conman after losing his parents at a young age. Money is his only priority in life and he tricks the greedy and gullible lot to make sure his monetary needs are met. However, things go awry when he gets caught by a gang of baddies. How he escapes from their clutches and finds the purpose to his life through a woman forms the story of Bluff Master.

movie.title: The Ruthless
movie.tagline: In Milan, the thirstiest wins.
movie.summary: Milan, Italy, 1967. Santo Russo, a boy of Calabrian origin, arrives north with his parents and younger brother to find better living conditions. Due to an absurd misunderstanding and his father's contempt, Santo ends up in prison, where he gets a “true education.” In 1978, he and his friends Slim and Mario embark on a 15-year criminal career, a successful and ruthless spiral of robberies, kidnappings, murders and heroin smuggling.

movie.title: Ghost Stories
movie.tagline: Your fears will find you.
movie.summary: An anthology of four short horror tales.

movie.title: Chhichhore
movie.tagline: Kutte ki dum, tedhi ki tedhi
movie.summary: Following a group of friends from university as they progress into middle-age life and go their own separate ways.

movie.title: Side Effects
movie.tagline: One pill can change your life.
movie.summary: A woman turns to prescription medication as a way of handling her anxiety concerning her husband's upcoming release from prison.

movie.title: Mathu Vadalara
movie.summary: Babu is a delivery boy living with his friends Yesu and Abhi. Due to his meagre salary, he decides to quit, but then Yesu gives him an idea. The idea, however, soon spirals out of control and Babu finds himself deep in trouble. Will he survive the circumstances of his own actions?

movie.title: Prati Roju Pandaage
movie.summary: Raghu Ramayya is a man with limited time to live. His children, who all live elsewhere, struggle to schedule their time around his death. But what happens when his grandson Saitakes it upon himself to give his grandfather the farewell he deserves?

movie.title: Shor in the City
movie.summary: Various residents and career-criminals face challenges in crime-laden Mumbai.
